#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

long long evaluate(const vector<long long>& seq, long long val, int lvl) {
    long long unit = seq[lvl];
    long long factor = val / unit;
    long long rem = val % unit;
    long long steps = factor * lvl;
    if (rem == 0) {
        return steps;
    }
    long long alt1 = steps + evaluate(seq, rem, lvl - 1);
    long long alt2 = steps + lvl + evaluate(seq, unit - rem, lvl - 1);
    return min(alt1, alt2);
}

int main() {
    long long input;
    cin >> input;
    
    vector<long long> sequence(17, 0);
    for (int pos = 1; pos < 17; pos++) {
        sequence[pos] = sequence[pos-1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    
    long long output = evaluate(sequence, input, 16);
    cout << output << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
